title: Instructions for a language model that writes tasks (authoring/<id>.llm.json)

mode.description: author = run offline on a PC with a strong model, output committed as a bank (.jsonl). device = run on the phone at play time (small model; restricted to story variation of verified parameters).

modelHint.description: Free text, e.g. 'any strong instruction model' / 'on-device <=1B'

instructions.description: Task-writing brief, with the regulation caps spelled out

examples.description: Few-shot examples in the OUTPUT format

format.description: params+story (RECOMMENDED): model returns numbers + wording, the pack's verifier computes the answer. full-task: model also proposes the answer, which must be reproduced by the verifier.

jsonSchema.description: Schema of one model output object

verifier.description: Deterministic check. Variables = output.params. The model's own answer is never trusted.

constraints.description: Must all be true (caps of the regulation, uniqueness, realism: price > 0 …)

answer.description: Typed value with {"$expr":…} fields, as in generators

mustAppearInText.description: Param names whose formatted value must occur in the story text

taskTemplate.description: Wrapper that turns a verified output into a compiled task (kind, input, answer from verifier, steps)
